```diff
diff --git a/src/AsciiBackgroundContext.jsx b/src/AsciiBackgroundContext.jsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1149b62
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/AsciiBackgroundContext.jsx
@@ -0,0 +1,246 @@
+import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
+import coyoteArt from './assets/ascii-defaults/coyote.json';
+import gatoArt from './assets/ascii-defaults/gato.json';
+import manosArt from './assets/ascii-defaults/manos.json';
+import pajaroArt from './assets/ascii-defaults/pajaro.json';
+
+const STORAGE_KEYS = {
+  backgroundId: 'dvpotro-ascii-background-id',
+  opacity: 'dvpotro-ascii-background-opacity',
+  customBackgrounds: 'dvpotro-ascii-custom-backgrounds',
+  customSelectedId: 'dvpotro-ascii-custom-selected-id',
+};
+
+export const ASCII_DEFAULT_BACKGROUNDS = [
+  { id: 'none', name: 'Ninguno', description: 'Sin fondo ASCII', art: null },
+  { id: 'manos', name: 'Manos', description: 'Manos en estilo ASCII', art: manosArt },
+  { id: 'coyote', name: 'Coyote', description: 'Mascota estilizada en ASCII', art: coyoteArt },
+  { id: 'gato', name: 'Gato', description: 'Silueta de gato en ASCII', art: gatoArt },
+  { id: 'pajaro', name: 'Pájaro', description: 'Ave ASCII de alto contraste', art: pajaroArt },
+];
+
+const DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_MAP = ASCII_DEFAULT_BACKGROUNDS.reduce((accumulator, background) => {
+  accumulator[background.id] = background;
+  return accumulator;
+}, {});
+
+const DEFAULT_OPACITY = 0.05;
+const MIN_OPACITY = 0.02;
+const MAX_OPACITY = 0.15;
+
+function clamp(value, min, max) {
+  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
+}
+
+function safeParse(value, fallback) {
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(value);
+  } catch (_error) {
+    return fallback;
+  }
+}
+
+function safeSave(key, value) {
+  try {
+    localStorage.setItem(key, value);
+    return true;
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.warn(`No se pudo guardar ${key} en localStorage`, error);
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+function loadBackgroundId() {
+  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
+    return 'none';
+  }
+
+  const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.backgroundId) || 'none';
+  if (saved === 'none' || saved === 'custom' || DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_MAP[saved]) {
+    return saved;
+  }
+
+  return 'none';
+}
+
+function loadOpacity() {
+  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
+    return DEFAULT_OPACITY;
+  }
+
+  const raw = Number(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.opacity));
+  if (!Number.isFinite(raw)) {
+    return DEFAULT_OPACITY;
+  }
+
+  return clamp(raw, MIN_OPACITY, MAX_OPACITY);
+}
+
+function loadCustomBackgrounds() {
+  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
+    return [];
+  }
+
+  const parsed = safeParse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.customBackgrounds) || '[]', []);
+  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
+    return [];
+  }
+
+  return parsed
+    .filter((item) => item && typeof item.id === 'string' && item.art?.grid?.length)
+    .map((item) => ({
+      id: item.id,
+      name: item.name || 'Fondo personalizado',
+      art: item.art,
+      thumbnail: item.thumbnail || '',
+    }));
+}
+
+function loadSelectedCustomId() {
+  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.customSelectedId) || null;
+}
+
+const AsciiBackgroundContext = createContext(null);
+
+export function AsciiBackgroundProvider({ children }) {
+  const [backgroundId, setBackgroundId] = useState(loadBackgroundId);
+  const [opacity, setOpacityState] = useState(loadOpacity);
+  const [customBackgrounds, setCustomBackgrounds] = useState(loadCustomBackgrounds);
+  const [selectedCustomBackgroundId, setSelectedCustomBackgroundId] = useState(loadSelectedCustomId);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    safeSave(STORAGE_KEYS.backgroundId, backgroundId);
+  }, [backgroundId]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    safeSave(STORAGE_KEYS.opacity, String(opacity));
+  }, [opacity]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    safeSave(STORAGE_KEYS.customBackgrounds, JSON.stringify(customBackgrounds));
+  }, [customBackgrounds]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    safeSave(STORAGE_KEYS.customSelectedId, selectedCustomBackgroundId || '');
+  }, [selectedCustomBackgroundId]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (backgroundId !== 'custom') {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const hasSelectedCustom = customBackgrounds.some((item) => item.id === selectedCustomBackgroundId);
+
+    if (!hasSelectedCustom) {
+      const nextSelected = customBackgrounds[0]?.id || null;
+      setSelectedCustomBackgroundId(nextSelected);
+
+      if (!nextSelected) {
+        setBackgroundId('none');
+      }
+    }
+  }, [backgroundId, customBackgrounds, selectedCustomBackgroundId]);
+
+  const currentBackground = useMemo(() => {
+    if (backgroundId === 'none') {
+      return null;
+    }
+
+    if (backgroundId === 'custom') {
+      return (
+        customBackgrounds.find((item) => item.id === selectedCustomBackgroundId)?.art ||
+        customBackgrounds[0]?.art ||
+        null
+      );
+    }
+
+    return DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_MAP[backgroundId]?.art || null;
+  }, [backgroundId, customBackgrounds, selectedCustomBackgroundId]);
+
+  const setBackground = useCallback(
+    (nextId) => {
+      if (nextId === 'none') {
+        setBackgroundId('none');
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_MAP[nextId]) {
+        setBackgroundId(nextId);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const custom = customBackgrounds.find((item) => item.id === nextId);
+      if (custom) {
+        setBackgroundId('custom');
+        setSelectedCustomBackgroundId(custom.id);
+      }
+    },
+    [customBackgrounds],
+  );
+
+  const addCustomBackground = useCallback((name, art, thumbnail) => {
+    const id = `custom-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
+    const entry = {
+      id,
+      name: name?.trim() || 'Fondo personalizado',
+      art,
+      thumbnail: thumbnail || '',
+    };
+
+    setCustomBackgrounds((previous) => [...previous, entry]);
+    setBackgroundId('custom');
+    setSelectedCustomBackgroundId(id);
+    return id;
+  }, []);
+
+  const removeCustomBackground = useCallback((id) => {
+    setCustomBackgrounds((previous) => previous.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
+    setSelectedCustomBackgroundId((current) => (current === id ? null : current));
+    setBackgroundId((current) => {
+      if (current === 'custom' && selectedCustomBackgroundId === id) {
+        return 'none';
+      }
+      return current;
+    });
+  }, [selectedCustomBackgroundId]);
+
+  const setOpacity = useCallback((nextOpacity) => {
+    setOpacityState(clamp(Number(nextOpacity), MIN_OPACITY, MAX_OPACITY));
+  }, []);
+
+  const value = useMemo(
+    () => ({
+      backgroundId,
+      currentBackground,
+      customBackgrounds,
+      opacity,
+      selectedCustomBackgroundId,
+      setBackground,
+      addCustomBackground,
+      removeCustomBackground,
+      setOpacity,
+    }),
+    [
+      addCustomBackground,
+      backgroundId,
+      currentBackground,
+      customBackgrounds,
+      opacity,
+      removeCustomBackground,
+      selectedCustomBackgroundId,
+      setBackground,
+      setOpacity,
+    ],
+  );
+
+  return <AsciiBackgroundContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AsciiBackgroundContext.Provider>;
+}
+
+export function useAsciiBackground() {
+  return useContext(AsciiBackgroundContext);
+}
+
```

### `src/components/AsciiBackdrop.jsx`
```diff
diff --git a/src/components/AsciiBackdrop.jsx b/src/components/AsciiBackdrop.jsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..05bd11d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/AsciiBackdrop.jsx
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import { useAsciiBackground } from '../AsciiBackgroundContext';
+import { decorateAsciiArt, renderAsciiBackdrop } from '../utils/asciiRendering';
+import { useTheme } from '../ThemeContext';
+
+function readMutedTextColor() {
+  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
+    return '#94a3b8';
+  }
+
+  const raw = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--text-muted').trim();
+  return raw || '#94a3b8';
+}
+
+export default function AsciiBackdrop() {
+  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
+  const rafRef = useRef(0);
+  const lastPaintRef = useRef(0);
+  const [textColor, setTextColor] = useState('#94a3b8');
+  const { currentBackground, opacity } = useAsciiBackground();
+  const { themeId } = useTheme();
+
+  const decoratedArt = useMemo(() => decorateAsciiArt(currentBackground), [currentBackground]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setTextColor(readMutedTextColor());
+  }, [themeId]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!decoratedArt?.grid?.length || !canvasRef.current) {
+      return undefined;
+    }
+
+    const paint = (time) => {
+      rafRef.current = window.requestAnimationFrame(paint);
+
+      if (lastPaintRef.current && time - lastPaintRef.current < 1000 / 24) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      lastPaintRef.current = time;
+      renderAsciiBackdrop(canvasRef.current, decoratedArt, {
+        opacity,
+        textColor,
+        time,
+        repeat: true,
+        animate: true,
+      });
+    };
+
+    const handleResize = () => {
+      lastPaintRef.current = 0;
+      renderAsciiBackdrop(canvasRef.current, decoratedArt, {
+        opacity,
+        textColor,
+        time: performance.now(),
+        repeat: true,
+        animate: true,
+      });
+    };
+
+    renderAsciiBackdrop(canvasRef.current, decoratedArt, {
+      opacity,
+      textColor,
+      time: performance.now(),
+      repeat: true,
+      animate: true,
+    });
+
+    rafRef.current = window.requestAnimationFrame(paint);
+    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
+
+    return () => {
+      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
+      window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
+    };
+  }, [decoratedArt, opacity, textColor]);
+
+  if (!decoratedArt) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <canvas
+      ref={canvasRef}
+      aria-hidden="true"
+      className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-0 h-full w-full"
+    />
+  );
+}
+
```

### `src/utils/asciiConverter.js`
```diff
diff --git a/src/utils/asciiConverter.js b/src/utils/asciiConverter.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..26cd0f7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/utils/asciiConverter.js
@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+const CHARSETS = {
+  density: ' .\'`^\",:;Il!i><~+_-?][}{1)(|\\/tfjrxnuvczXYUJCLQ0OZmwqpdbkhao*#MW&8%B@$',
+  blocks: ' ░▒▓█',
+  binary: ' #',
+};
+
+function getCharset(name) {
+  return CHARSETS[name] || CHARSETS.density;
+}
+
+function clamp(value, min, max) {
+  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
+}
+
+export function loadImageFromFile(file) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const img = new Image();
+    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
+
+    img.onload = () => {
+      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+      resolve(img);
+    };
+
+    img.onerror = (error) => {
+      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+      reject(error);
+    };
+
+    img.src = url;
+  });
+}
+
+export function imageToAscii(imageElement, options = {}) {
+  const {
+    columns = 120,
+    charset = 'density',
+    invert = false,
+  } = options;
+
+  if (!imageElement) return null;
+
+  const sourceWidth = imageElement.naturalWidth || imageElement.width;
+  const sourceHeight = imageElement.naturalHeight || imageElement.height;
+  if (!sourceWidth || !sourceHeight) return null;
+
+  const targetColumns = Math.max(1, Math.round(columns));
+  const targetRows = Math.max(1, Math.round((sourceHeight / sourceWidth) * targetColumns * 0.5));
+
+  const sampleWidth = targetColumns * 8;
+  const sampleHeight = targetRows * 8;
+
+  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
+  canvas.width = sampleWidth;
+  canvas.height = sampleHeight;
+
+  const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
+  if (!context) return null;
+
+  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
+  context.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
+  context.clearRect(0, 0, sampleWidth, sampleHeight);
+  context.drawImage(imageElement, 0, 0, sampleWidth, sampleHeight);
+
+  const imageData = context.getImageData(0, 0, sampleWidth, sampleHeight).data;
+  const charsetChars = getCharset(charset);
+  const maxIndex = charsetChars.length - 1;
+  const grid = [];
+
+  const blockWidth = sampleWidth / targetColumns;
+  const blockHeight = sampleHeight / targetRows;
+
+  for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < targetRows; rowIndex += 1) {
+    const row = [];
+    const yStart = Math.floor(rowIndex * blockHeight);
+    const yEnd = Math.floor((rowIndex + 1) * blockHeight);
+
+    for (let columnIndex = 0; columnIndex < targetColumns; columnIndex += 1) {
+      const xStart = Math.floor(columnIndex * blockWidth);
+      const xEnd = Math.floor((columnIndex + 1) * blockWidth);
+
+      let sum = 0;
+      let count = 0;
+
+      for (let y = yStart; y < yEnd; y += 1) {
+        for (let x = xStart; x < xEnd; x += 1) {
+          const pixelIndex = (y * sampleWidth + x) * 4;
+          const red = imageData[pixelIndex];
+          const green = imageData[pixelIndex + 1];
+          const blue = imageData[pixelIndex + 2];
+          const alpha = imageData[pixelIndex + 3] / 255;
+          const brightness = ((0.299 * red) + (0.587 * green) + (0.114 * blue)) * alpha + (255 * (1 - alpha));
+          sum += brightness;
+          count += 1;
+        }
+      }
+
+      const avgBrightness = clamp(Math.round(sum / Math.max(1, count)), 0, 255);
+      const normalized = avgBrightness / 255;
+      const mapped = invert ? normalized : 1 - normalized;
+      const charIndex = clamp(Math.round(mapped * maxIndex), 0, maxIndex);
+
+      row.push({
+        char: charsetChars[charIndex] || charsetChars[maxIndex],
+        brightness: avgBrightness,
+      });
+    }
+
+    grid.push(row);
+  }
+
+  return {
+    rows: targetRows,
+    columns: targetColumns,
+    grid,
+  };
+}
```

### `src/utils/asciiRendering.js`
```diff
diff --git a/src/utils/asciiRendering.js b/src/utils/asciiRendering.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..961c6be
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/utils/asciiRendering.js
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+const DEFAULT_FONT_FAMILY = '\'JetBrains Mono\', \'Fira Code\', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace';
+
+export function clamp(value, min, max) {
+  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
+}
+
+export function hashString(input = '') {
+  return String(input)
+    .split('')
+    .reduce((hash, char) => {
+      const nextHash = (hash << 5) - hash + char.charCodeAt(0);
+      return nextHash | 0;
+    }, 0);
+}
+
+export function decorateAsciiArt(art) {
+  if (!art?.grid) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  const cells = art.grid.flatMap((row, rowIndex) =>
+    row.map((cell, columnIndex) => ({
+      ...cell,
+      rowIndex,
+      columnIndex,
+      phase: ((hashString(`${rowIndex}:${columnIndex}:${cell.char}:${cell.brightness}`) >>> 0) % 1000) / 1000 * Math.PI * 2,
+    })),
+  );
+
+  return {
+    rows: art.rows || art.grid.length || 0,
+    columns: art.columns || art.grid[0]?.length || 0,
+    grid: art.grid,
+    cells,
+  };
+}
+
+function getCellMetrics(width, height, columns, rows, scaleMultiplier = 1.1) {
+  const smallestSide = Math.min(width / Math.max(columns, 1), height / Math.max(rows, 1));
+  const fontSize = clamp(smallestSide * scaleMultiplier, 3, 12);
+  const charWidth = fontSize * 0.62;
+  const charHeight = fontSize * 1.08;
+  return {
+    fontSize,
+    charWidth,
+    charHeight,
+    tileWidth: charWidth * columns,
+    tileHeight: charHeight * rows,
+  };
+}
+
+function drawAsciiCells(ctx, art, options) {
+  const {
+    width,
+    height,
+    opacity = 0.05,
+    time = 0,
+    textColor = '#94a3b8',
+    repeat = true,
+    animate = true,
+    scaleMultiplier = 1.1,
+  } = options;
+
+  const decorated = art?.cells ? art : decorateAsciiArt(art);
+  if (!decorated?.grid?.length) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const rows = decorated.rows;
+  const columns = decorated.columns;
+  const { fontSize, charWidth, charHeight, tileWidth, tileHeight } = getCellMetrics(
+    width,
+    height,
+    columns,
+    rows,
+    scaleMultiplier,
+  );
+  const shouldRepeat = repeat && tileWidth < width * 0.85 && tileHeight < height * 0.85;
+  const startX = shouldRepeat ? -tileWidth * 0.25 : (width - tileWidth) / 2;
+  const startY = shouldRepeat ? -tileHeight * 0.25 : (height - tileHeight) / 2;
+  const endX = shouldRepeat ? width + tileWidth * 0.25 : startX + tileWidth;
+  const endY = shouldRepeat ? height + tileHeight * 0.25 : startY + tileHeight;
+
+  ctx.save();
+  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
+  ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
+  ctx.font = `${fontSize}px ${DEFAULT_FONT_FAMILY}`;
+  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
+  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
+
+  for (let tileY = startY; tileY < endY; tileY += tileHeight) {
+    for (let tileX = startX; tileX < endX; tileX += tileWidth) {
+      for (const cell of decorated.cells) {
+        const brightnessAlpha = clamp(1 - cell.brightness / 255, 0.08, 1);
+        const breathing = animate
+          ? 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(time * 0.0005 + cell.phase)
+          : 1;
+        ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(opacity * brightnessAlpha * breathing, 0.01, 1);
+        ctx.fillText(
+          cell.char,
+          tileX + cell.columnIndex * charWidth,
+          tileY + cell.rowIndex * charHeight,
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  ctx.restore();
+}
+
+export function renderAsciiBackdrop(canvas, art, options = {}) {
+  if (!canvas || !art?.grid?.length) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true, willReadFrequently: false });
+  if (!context) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.width || window.innerWidth || 0));
+  const height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.height || window.innerHeight || 0));
+  const dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
+
+  if (canvas.width !== Math.floor(width * dpr) || canvas.height !== Math.floor(height * dpr)) {
+    canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
+    canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
+    canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
+    canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;
+  }
+
+  context.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
+  drawAsciiCells(context, art, {
+    width,
+    height,
+    opacity: options.opacity ?? 0.05,
+    time: options.time ?? 0,
+    textColor: options.textColor ?? '#94a3b8',
+    repeat: options.repeat ?? true,
+    animate: options.animate ?? true,
+    scaleMultiplier: options.scaleMultiplier ?? 1.1,
+  });
+}
+
+export function createAsciiThumbnailDataUrl(art, options = {}) {
+  if (!art?.grid?.length || typeof document === 'undefined') {
+    return '';
+  }
+
+  const width = Math.max(40, Math.floor(options.width || 120));
+  const height = Math.max(28, Math.floor(options.height || 80));
+  const dpr = Math.max(1, options.dpr || 2);
+  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
+  canvas.width = width * dpr;
+  canvas.height = height * dpr;
+  canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
+  canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;
+
+  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
+  if (!context) {
+    return '';
+  }
+
+  context.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
+  context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
+  context.fillStyle = options.backgroundColor || 'rgba(0,0,0,0)';
+  context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
+
+  const decorated = decorateAsciiArt(art);
+  if (!decorated?.grid?.length) {
+    return '';
+  }
+
+  const rows = decorated.rows;
+  const columns = decorated.columns;
+  const fontSize = clamp(Math.min(width / columns, height / rows) * 1.15, 2.5, 6);
+  const charWidth = fontSize * 0.62;
+  const charHeight = fontSize * 1.08;
+  const tileWidth = charWidth * columns;
+  const tileHeight = charHeight * rows;
+  const offsetX = (width - tileWidth) / 2;
+  const offsetY = (height - tileHeight) / 2;
+  const textColor = options.textColor || '#94a3b8';
+
+  context.save();
+  context.fillStyle = textColor;
+  context.font = `${fontSize}px ${DEFAULT_FONT_FAMILY}`;
+  context.textBaseline = 'top';
+  context.textAlign = 'left';
+
+  for (const cell of decorated.cells) {
+    const brightnessAlpha = clamp(1 - cell.brightness / 255, 0.08, 1);
+    context.globalAlpha = clamp(brightnessAlpha * (options.opacityMultiplier ?? 1), 0.08, 1);
+    context.fillText(
+      cell.char,
+      offsetX + cell.columnIndex * charWidth,
+      offsetY + cell.rowIndex * charHeight,
+    );
+  }
+
+  context.restore();
+  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
+}
+
```
